failureResolution: Two bilingual reduced-motion cases had ambiguous accessible-name selectors after adding a second synchronized pause control. Scoped the original controls to the avatar exhibit and asserted the header state also follows.

The avatar pause/refresh case started its post-refresh action sequence before the optional ice scene settled. Trace showed the greeting began, then native smooth scrolling moved the character offscreen and correctly cancelled it. Added the same explicit scene-ready wait already used by openReady; three independent repeats pass without changing avatar runtime or timing.
Added a separate injected shader-initialization failure case; it passes with static fallback, usable navigation and no page errors.
